title: Sections of an etale sheaf pulled back to a connected geometric fibre
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on the small etale site $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], with geometric stalk $F_{\bar s}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Let $h:U\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ be a scheme over $\Omega$. The inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] of $F$ along $U\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ is canonically the constant sheaf with value $F_{\bar s}$ on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. If $U$ is nonempty and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme], its global sections are canonically $F_{\bar s}$. This identification is natural in $U$: for every $\Omega$-morphism $v:V\to U$, the pullback of the section corresponding to $a\in F_{\bar s}$ is the constant section with value $a$ on $V$, whether or not $V$ is connected.
